title: Ive Sent It — send any files, to anyone, anywhere, in the world
excerpt: Premium, custom file sending. Send any files, to anyone, anywhere, in the world — and watch every delivery land live, with controls that stay yours after you hit send.
content_html:
How it works

Every file, cared for from the moment you let go.

No accounts to open, nothing to install. You drop — we handle the checking, the protecting and the delivering, so you never have to think about the how.

  1. 01

    Drop it

    Add as many files or whole folders as you like — up to 3 GB per send free, 3 TB a file on Pro, 5 TB on Team. Nothing to zip, no account to open.

  2. 02

    Address it, then arm it

    Say who it’s for — an email or an @username. Then make it yours: add a password, lock it to countries with GeoWall, set a release time, make it view-once, or send it under your own brand.

  3. 03

    We’ll check & seal it

    Every file is scanned for anything unsafe, then sealed to the rules you set in 02 — password-locked, geo-fenced, even ID-verified, so it opens only for the person you chose. Every delivery ships with a signed certificate your recipient can verify, so no one can pretend to be you.

  4. 04

    Watch it land — and stay in charge

    See the moment it’s opened and downloaded, with signed proof of delivery when you need it. And the link stays yours: extend it, cap it, or switch it off at any time — even after sending.

Things no one else does

Not just a file sender — a premium, custom delivery service, for individuals and enterprises alike.

Most tools stop caring the moment a file leaves. These are the things that make Ive Sent It different — and most of them exist nowhere else.

Nobody else

Living links

Change your mind after you’ve sent it. Turn a link off, extend it, add a password or cap the downloads — instantly. The only send that stays yours.

Nobody else

Deliveries worth opening

Files that arrive as an experience, using our living templates: a wax-sealed letter, a parcel to unbox, a mixtape that plays, a blueprint that unrolls, a runway collection to unzip. Your logo, colours and type on every one — recipients don’t click a link, they open a delivery.

Nobody else

Registered mail for the internet

A signed, timestamped, geo-stamped certificate of exactly who opened your files — when, and where. And recipients get the mirror: every delivery carries a signed certificate they can verify in the browser, so a forged “you’ve been sent files” email fools no one.

Nobody else

GeoWall™

Lock a delivery to the countries you choose. Everywhere else, the door simply won’t open.

Nobody else

Forensic watermark

Every download quietly marked per person, so a leak traces straight back.

Get paid on delivery

Put a price on any delivery — your client pays by card and the files unlock. A photo set, a track, the final invoice: any send becomes a sale, in any of 135 currencies, straight to your own Stripe account. We take 0%.

Nobody else

Scheduled release

It exists now, but only opens at the moment you choose — perfect for embargoes and launches.

Nobody else

ID-verified delivery

For your most sensitive files: the recipient proves it’s really them before anything unlocks — from an emailed code up to a full liveness ID check on Team — and a forwarded link stays locked to everyone else.

File requests

Send a branded link that lets others send files to you — no account needed on their side, every file scanned, landing straight in your deliveries.

New

Your name on the door

A delivery space on your own domain — your logo, colours and templates on every page, and every link you send wearing your address, not ours.

View-once

Collected exactly once, then destroyed. For the files that should never live in an inbox.

Choose your region

Keep every delivery in the US or Europe — a promise you can put in a contract.

New

Built for developers

A real REST API and signed webhooks — send deliveries from your own code, with every guarantee the app has. Pro and above.

Who it's for

The file-sending service for the world.

Big memories or big masters — if email can’t take it, it belongs here. One home for every delivery, every kind of sender.

For the individual

The wedding film, a lifetime of photos, the documents that matter — too big for email, too precious for a random link. Free to start, careful always.

Videographers & filmmakers

Terabytes of masters, delivered effortlessly — not couriered. And the confidential cut stays confidential: watermarked per person, locked to countries, gone after one viewing.

Photographers

Deliver the shoot as a private view — your name on the door, watermarks on the proofs, and word the second your client opens it.

Designers & agencies

The handover lives on your domain, in your colours — and when round three becomes round four, the same link just updates. Never send “final_v7” again.

Musicians & producers

Stems and masters for exactly the right ears — ID-checked before it plays, watermarked per listener, so a leak names its leaker.

Marketers & PR

One send to the whole press list — nothing unlocks before the embargo lifts, everyone gets their own link, and you know exactly who opened what before you chase.

Legal & finance

Registered mail for the internet — the recipient proves who they are before anything opens, and you hold a signed certificate of who, when and where.

Architects & engineers

Full issue sets — models, drawings, folder structure intact — and a link that always points at the current revision, never the superseded one.

Government & public sector

Case files that travel by the book — ID-verified recipients, a full audit trail, and data that never leaves the region the law requires.

Charities & NGOs

Field reports and beneficiary records moved safely between offices, partners and funders — with the care the people inside those files deserve.

Whatever you make

If it’s too big, too precious or too private for email, this is its way to travel.

For teams & enterprise

Grown-up controls, without the grown-up headache.

One board for the whole team

A shared workspace with roles and per-person permissions — everyone sends as the team, and the team sees every delivery land.

Your brand, your domain

Deliveries and file requests on your own address, wearing your logo, colours and type — the client never leaves your world.

Know exactly who opened it

ID-verified delivery — up to a face-match check — and per-person watermarks for the files that must not wander.

One sign-in, rules set once

Company SSO, with defaults — passwords, expiry, allowed countries — applied to everyone automatically. Coming with Enterprise.

An audit trail you can hand over

A complete, exportable record of every send and open, ready for compliance and legal. Coming with Enterprise.

Your data, where you need it

Choose the region your files live in — with your own encryption keys on Enterprise.

Plans

Free to start. Grows with you.

One simple price, everything included — no per-gigabyte meter, no surprises. Cancel anytime.

Every file, cared for from the moment you let go.

No accounts to open, nothing to install. You drop — we handle the checking, the protecting and the delivering, so you never have to think about the how.

  1. 01Drop itAdd as many files or whole folders as you like — up to 3 GB per send free, 3 TB a file on Pro, 5 TB on Team. Nothing to zip, no account to open.
  2. 02Address it, then arm itSay who it’s for — an email or an @username. Then make it yours: add a password, lock it to countries with GeoWall, set a release time, make it view-once, or send it under your own brand.
  3. 03We’ll check & seal itEvery file is scanned for anything unsafe, then sealed to the rules you set in 02 — password-locked, geo-fenced, even ID-verified, so it opens only for the person you chose. Every delivery ships with a signed certificate your recipient can verify, so no one can pretend to be you.
  4. 04Watch it land — and stay in chargeSee the moment it’s opened and downloaded, with signed proof of delivery when you need it. And the link stays yours: extend it, cap it, or switch it off at any time — even after sending.

Things no one else does

Not just a file sender — a premium, custom delivery service, for individuals and enterprises alike.

Most tools stop caring the moment a file leaves. These are the things that make Ive Sent It different — and most of them exist nowhere else.

Nobody else

Living links

Change your mind after you’ve sent it. Turn a link off, extend it, add a password or cap the downloads — instantly. The only send that stays yours.

Nobody else

Deliveries worth opening

Files that arrive as an experience, using our living templates: a wax-sealed letter, a parcel to unbox, a mixtape that plays, a blueprint that unrolls, a runway collection to unzip. Your logo, colours and type on every one — recipients don’t click a link, they open a delivery.

Nobody else

Registered mail for the internet

A signed, timestamped, geo-stamped certificate of exactly who opened your files — when, and where. And recipients get the mirror: every delivery carries a signed certificate they can verify in the browser, so a forged “you’ve been sent files” email fools no one.

Nobody else

GeoWall™

Lock a delivery to the countries you choose. Everywhere else, the door simply won’t open.

Nobody else

Forensic watermark

Every download quietly marked per person, so a leak traces straight back.

Get paid on delivery

Put a price on any delivery — your client pays by card and the files unlock. A photo set, a track, the final invoice: any send becomes a sale, in any of 135 currencies, straight to your own Stripe account. We take 0%.

Nobody else

Scheduled release

It exists now, but only opens at the moment you choose — perfect for embargoes and launches.

Nobody else

ID-verified delivery

For your most sensitive files: the recipient proves it’s really them before anything unlocks — from an emailed code up to a full liveness ID check on Team — and a forwarded link stays locked to everyone else.

File requests

Send a branded link that lets others send files to you — no account needed on their side, every file scanned, landing straight in your deliveries.

New

Your name on the door

A delivery space on your own domain — your logo, colours and templates on every page, and every link you send wearing your address, not ours.

View-once

Collected exactly once, then destroyed. For the files that should never live in an inbox.

Choose your region

Keep every delivery in the US or Europe — a promise you can put in a contract.

New

Built for developers

A real REST API and signed webhooks — send deliveries from your own code, with every guarantee the app has. Pro and above.

The file-sending service for the world.

Big memories or big masters — if email can’t take it, it belongs here. One home for every delivery, every kind of sender.

For the individual

The wedding film, a lifetime of photos, the documents that matter — too big for email, too precious for a random link. Free to start, careful always.

Videographers & filmmakers

Terabytes of masters, delivered effortlessly — not couriered. And the confidential cut stays confidential: watermarked per person, locked to countries, gone after one viewing.

Photographers

Deliver the shoot as a private view — your name on the door, watermarks on the proofs, and word the second your client opens it.

Designers & agencies

The handover lives on your domain, in your colours — and when round three becomes round four, the same link just updates. Never send “final_v7” again.

Musicians & producers

Stems and masters for exactly the right ears — ID-checked before it plays, watermarked per listener, so a leak names its leaker.

Marketers & PR

One send to the whole press list — nothing unlocks before the embargo lifts, everyone gets their own link, and you know exactly who opened what before you chase.

Legal & finance

Registered mail for the internet — the recipient proves who they are before anything opens, and you hold a signed certificate of who, when and where.

Architects & engineers

Full issue sets — models, drawings, folder structure intact — and a link that always points at the current revision, never the superseded one.

Government & public sector

Case files that travel by the book — ID-verified recipients, a full audit trail, and data that never leaves the region the law requires.

Charities & NGOs

Field reports and beneficiary records moved safely between offices, partners and funders — with the care the people inside those files deserve.

Whatever you make

If it’s too big, too precious or too private for email, this is its way to travel.

For teams & enterprise

Grown-up controls, without the grown-up headache.

One board for the whole team

A shared workspace with roles and per-person permissions — everyone sends as the team, and the team sees every delivery land.

Your brand, your domain

Deliveries and file requests on your own address, wearing your logo, colours and type — the client never leaves your world.

Know exactly who opened it

ID-verified delivery — up to a face-match check — and per-person watermarks for the files that must not wander.

One sign-in, rules set once

Company SSO, with defaults — passwords, expiry, allowed countries — applied to everyone automatically. Coming with Enterprise.

An audit trail you can hand over

A complete, exportable record of every send and open, ready for compliance and legal. Coming with Enterprise.

Your data, where you need it

Choose the region your files live in — with your own encryption keys on Enterprise.
